<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!ENTITY internal 'parameter-entity-content'>">
  %pe;
  <!ENTITY gen "general-entity-&internal;">
  <?pi-target pi-data="value"?>
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="style.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns/sub" sub:id="123">
  <!-- Comment containing DTD references and CDATA -->
  <sub:child sub:attr="&gen;">
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw CDATA text with <tags> and entities &gen; inside.
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; and Second">
  <!ENTITY % nested_pe "<!ENTITY ent3 '&ent2; with PE'>">
  %nested_pe;
  <?target-pi data-attr="test"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:x="http://example.org/x" xmlns:y="http://example.org/y">
  <!-- Multi-namespace comment block -->
  <x:item>&ent3;</x:item>
  <y:item>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA inside a prefixed element with a &ent3; reference.
    ]]>
  </y:item>
</catalog>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ext_pe SYSTEM "http://localhost/nonexistent.dtd">
  %ext_pe;
  <!ENTITY base "Base Entity">
  <!ENTITY derived "&base; + Extra">
  <?xml-debug level="high"?>
]>
<doc xmlns="http://xml.org/doc" xmlns:m="http://xml.org/meta">
  <!-- Complex comment with hyphens -- -- inside -->
  <m:section m:verified="true">
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA block testing parser robustness against CDATA edge cases.
    ]]>
    &derived;
  </m:section>
</doc>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ref "ReferenceValue">
  <!ENTITY % defs "
    <!ENTITY entA 'A'>
    <!ENTITY entB '&entA;B'>
  ">
  %defs;
  <?archive-info status="active"?>
]>
<archive xmlns="http://archive.org/ns" xmlns:meta="http://archive.org/meta" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment with xml entity references &ref; inside -->
  <meta:record xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.com">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section with entity expansion attempt: &entB;
    ]]>
  </meta:record>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE container [
  <!ELEMENT container (data)*>
  <!ELEMENT data (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY alpha "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY beta "α Beta">
  <!ENTITY gamma "β Gamma">
  <!ENTITY delta "γ Delta">
  <?container-processor engine="v2"?>
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY manual SYSTEM "manual.txt" NDATA txt>
]>
<container xmlns="http://ns.example.com/container" xmlns:ext="http://ns.example.com/ext">
  <!-- Top-level comment before deep entity reference -->
  <ext:data ext:index="1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block checking processing of multiple entity chains: δ
    ]]>
  </ext:data>
  <data>δ</data>
</container>
```
